messages:
alice: CI red on my PR #3421 — flaky unit failure in runtime/serving_engine/tests/test_stream_window_boundary.py::test_window_boundary_race. Happens on linux-worker-7
ben: saw it in the matrix, looks timing-related. quick paste of the failing assert from the job logs:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 3 chunks but got 2
E   assert contiguous windows: [0,1,3] vs [0,1,2]
E   runtime/serving_engine/stream_window.py:142
```
alice: i reran the failing job once, failed again. pytest-randomly seed=94321 was included in the run metadata
ci-bot: build 48721 failed for PR #3421 — https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/48721
carmen: can someone rerun the job a couple times? often transient on the runner
alice: rerun requested, reran once manually — still failed (2/2)
dave: can you try reproducing locally with same seed? e.g. `pytest -k test_stream_window_boundary_race -q -s --maxfail=1 --randomly-seed=94321`
alice: running local harness now. also tried `pytest -k test_stream_window_boundary_race -n0` to avoid xdist, repro rate ~1/30 so far
ben: try the lighter harness: `python -m tests.harness.stream_repro --seed 94321 --repeat 100` — that often exposes the race faster
alice: started the harness, saw one repro after ~27 runs
eva: @alice thanks for the seed. I can bisect the change range if you want — I suspect the prefetch reorder in b2c4e8 is the culprit
carmen: adding flaky-test label to the PR to avoid auto-merge for now
dev-bot: label added: flaky-test on PR #3421 by automation
eva: starting git bisect between 9f3a7..b2c4e (the timeframe of the prefetch refactor). will run the harness on each step and report back
ben: if bisect points to b2c4e8, it's probably the reorder of enqueue -> flush. ordering fence probably dropped
dave: avoid inserting sleeps as patch. better: sequence number check or compare expected window id before flush and drop out-of-order flushes
eva: bisect update: first bad commit identified: b2c4e8 (prefetch: reorder window enqueue) — reproduces 3/20 runs on the harness with seed variation
alice: confirms locally: checkout b2c4e8 + harness = repro in ~1/10 runs
ben: ok that nails it. @alice can you try a small fix — enforce monotonic window sequence in enqueue, or guard flush behind sequence check
alice: pushing a draft fix PR 3430 with a sequence-number guard in enqueue (no sleeps). locally ran 200 harness iterations: 0 repros so far
carmen: nice, can someone trigger the full CI matrix on that PR to be safe
ci-bot: re-run requested for PR 3430 — https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/48730 :started:
alice: thanks all. leaving the bisect logs and harness command in the PR description for follow-up
dave: once CI is green, let's follow up with a small integration test that fuzzes reorderings to prevent regression
ben: adding a test to the fuzz suite now — will link once up
alice: great, will keep monitoring. big thanks :thumbsup: to @eva for the bisect and @ben for the harness tips
